words.sourceMeaning: ~의 영향을 받는, ~을 겪는 (이 글에서는 전통과 현대성 사이의 긴장에 영향을 받는다는 뜻)

meanings.en: Likely to be affected or influenced by something.
meanings.wrongEn: Having the power to control others.

words.sourceMeaning: 필수적인, 없어서는 안 될 (an integral part of : ~의 필수적인 부분)

meanings.en: Necessary and important as a part of a whole.
meanings.wrongEn: Easy to remove without any effect on the rest.

words.sourceMeaning: 유지하다, 보유하다 (이미 가진 가치나 특성을 계속 지닌다는 뜻)

meanings.en: To continue to have or keep something.
meanings.wrongEn: To give something away to a stranger.

words.sourceMeaning: 단열 (열이 드나드는 것을 줄이는 것. insulation은 isolation ‘고립, 격리’와 구별)

meanings.en: Material or a method that reduces the flow of heat into or out of something.
meanings.wrongEn: A system that sends electricity from one city to another.

words.sourceMeaning: 기밀성 (공기가 틈새로 새어 들어오거나 나가지 않도록 막는 성질)

meanings.en: The quality of not letting air pass in or out through gaps.
meanings.wrongEn: The quality of being able to float easily on water.

words.sourceMeaning: 열 회수 환기 (실내 공기를 내보내면서 그 열을 회수하여 들어오는 공기와 열을 교환하는 환기 방식)

meanings.en: A ventilation system that removes indoor air while reusing its heat to warm the incoming fresh air.
meanings.wrongEn: A method of cooling food quickly by placing it in ice.

meanings.en: The typical way in which a person or group lives.
meanings.wrongEn: A type of clothing worn only for sports.

meanings.en: A traditional way of behaving or doing something in a society.
meanings.wrongEn: A written invitation to a formal dinner.

meanings.en: A soft green or black growth that forms on damp surfaces or old food.
meanings.wrongEn: A thin layer of paint used to protect metal from rust.

meanings.en: A hollow container used to give a shape to liquid material as it hardens.
meanings.wrongEn: A soft cushion placed on a chair for comfort.

words.sourceMeaning: 긴장, 갈등 (여기서는 전통과 현대성 사이에서 서로 당기는 갈등 관계)

meanings.en: A situation in which different forces, ideas, or groups pull against each other.
meanings.wrongEn: A feeling of calm agreement between everyone involved.
